title: Proteus app capability manifest
description: Declarative capability contract for launcher / EnvGate gating. Spec: docs/proteus/APPLICATIONS.md.

id.description: Stable manifest id (often matches a desktop id stem).

desktopIds.description: Desktop entry ids to match (with or without .desktop).

match.description: Optional case-insensitive regex against id/name/genericName/exec when desktopIds miss.

requires.description: Capabilities that must all be present (Hardware.has).

requiresAny.description: At least one of these capabilities must be present.

permissions.description: User grants required via Permissions.qml (allow only; ask/deny block). Fail-open until store ready.

reason.description: Human string shown when search surfaces a blocked app.

prefers.description: Soft hints for shaping (v1 unused by EnvGate).

device_classes.description: Optional device-class allow-list (v1 unused by EnvGate).
